summary: Initial control-plane foundation: scoped fleet UI, hashed agent enrollment, ASGI long polling, controlled batches, credential rotation/revocation, central backups, and audited recovery.
highlights: Scoped fleet models/UI with hashed enrollment and bearer credentials over Uvicorn ASGI long polling.
Monotonic events, snapshot replacement, controlled batches, and two-phase rotation/revocation.
Central backup creation, audited recovery deployment, and 90-day sanitized-log retention.
